scope: Per-factory hint eligibility history and assignment acknowledgement for the Upgrades prototype, with shared save normalization and undo support
behavior: Optional researchHintHistory stores assignmentAcknowledged and ordered title/detail copies with GameState
Engine publications collect eligible hints even while the modal is closed; visible clues are saved before paint
Close/reopen, recipe/map transitions and normalized saved-factory reload preserve retired clues; live progression still selects the primary
Saved assignment can be reread without replaying the introduction on reopen/load; existing Wood/Kiln progress also acknowledges the intro
Fresh factories seed only current candidates; unreached author-review entries are not bulk unlocked
Manual slots, copied slots, autosaves and JSON round trips preserve isolated records; no global browser hint-history key
Undo retains learned knowledge and acknowledgement; replacement with another factory does not merge history
Malformed optional metadata is cleaned without rejecting the factory; duplicate titles update in place and loaded history is bounded to 256 copies
Reload factory snapshot is an external isolated serialization/normalization control; whole author-page reload still starts its initial fixture
